minutes.headline: Select Board revoked the Reboot's alcohol license and two auto dealer licenses; town manager announced her resignation.
minutes.summary: The board reorganized, electing a new chair, vice chair and clerk. It revoked the Reboot's alcohol license over unpaid sewer bills, then revoked the licenses of Maxi Auto and Lunenburg Auto Center after police and state trooper testimony. It heard a clean FY2023 audit, ratified two appointments, and the town manager read her resignation letter, after which the board tabled the rest of old business.

what_happened.line: The Select Board voted to revoke all licenses of Lunenburg Auto Center and Maxi Auto Inc, with vehicles to be removed within 7 days.
The board found the Reboot in violation of its December 2023 payment agreement on back sewer payments, then voted to rescind its alcohol license.
The town manager read her resignation letter, and the board then tabled most remaining old and current business.
The board reorganized and elected a new chair; the votes for vice chair and clerk were not audible in the recording.
The auditor presented the FY2023 audit, and the board ratified two appointments, a planning board assistant and a seasonal lifeguard.

why_it_matters: Two licensed businesses and a bar's alcohol license ended over unpaid sewer bills and police findings, which touches who operates in town and whether sewer arrears are collected.
The town manager's resignation leaves the town without its chief administrator, who prepares the budget the board and Town Meeting will be asked to vote on.
watch_next: Whether the vice chair and clerk elections, not audible in the recording, are confirmed in the town's official minutes.
The old and current business the board tabled, which has no new date in the minutes.
